verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents on-site shredding of unwanted mail, with destruction certificates available on request. It also lets users choose per item to have mail shipped unopened or opened and scanned, which covers shredding with confirmation and some per-item disposal choice. There is no documented physical-mail storage window: the 'unlimited cloud storage' claim covers scanned digital copies, not how long originals are kept. Missing for 10: documented physical storage/retention windows, explicit per-item shred-request workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I control what happens to the physical mail — documented storage windows, on-request shredding with confirmation, and per-item disposal choices
